To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
quality in a service is a function of: (a) the consumer's expectations, (b) the service performance, and (c) the consumer's perceived value of the service.
service quality is defined by the degree to which a service meets the expectations of the consumer.

quality in services is a multidimensional, multiattribute, multi-actor concept, and that it has three major dimensions: technical quality (the quality of the core service), functional quality (the quality and responsiveness of the supporting service system), and interactional quality (the quality in the service encounters).
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: (a) the conceptualization and operationalization of the service quality construct, (b) the identification of the dimensions of quality in a service, (c) the identification of antecedents to quality in a service and (d) the development of propositions about quality in a service.
the development of a model that will serve as a conceptual framework for research into service quality.
the development of a conceptual model of service quality, and with a set of propositions and implications for future research.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
quality is the degree of excellence with which the service is performed.
service quality is the customer's perception of the service delivery system compared with the customer's expectations of the service.

service quality is a multidimensional construct that includes the technical quality and the functional quality of the service, as well as the responsiveness, assurance, empathy, and tangibles of the service provider.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
service quality is a function of three factors: technical quality, functional quality, and interaction quality.
the quality of a service is the customer's perception of the service performance relative to expectations.
service quality is a function of the customer's perception of the service and the customer's expectations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
quality in services is not a single dimension but a multidimensional construct.
service quality is a function of both the service provider's performance and the consumer's perception of that performance.
the quality of a service is a function of the quality of its delivery and its outcome.
